name: Citi (Citigroup) - Pune
pune_evidence: Official Citi job posts located in Pune: 'Quantitative Technology Developer - Python and C++ - VP' (Analytical Calculation Engine, ACE), 'Counterparty Credit Risk Quant Technology Lead' (ACE, Commodities pricing/risk), 'Markets Price and Model Risk and Control SVP', and 'Business Model Validation and Implementation - Analyst II' (Risk Management / Model Development & Analytics).
what_they_do_in_pune: Builds Citi's strategic derivatives credit-risk/exposure engine (ACE) and commodities pricing/risk analytics, plus model validation and Markets model-risk control.
personalization_hook: Citi's Pune ACE team builds the firm's strategic platform for derivatives counterparty-credit-risk and exposure calculations, implementing pricing and exposure models with Quantitative Research.
winter_internship_plausibility_reason: Citi India runs structured summer analyst programs and a posted 'US Consumer Cards Risk - Intern' role listing Pune among locations (posted 30 Mar 2026), but no winter/December program seen; a 6-week Dec slot would need an exception via a hiring manager.
notes: Strongest Pune quant evidence of any bank found. Intern posting: https://jobs.citi.com/job/bengaluru/us-consumer-cards-risk-intern/287/93375592576 (locations Bengaluru, Mumbai, Haryana, Pune). No recruiting email published on any posting checked.

pune_evidence: Pune-located DB postings: 'DWS Senior Risk Analyst - Model Validation' (Pune - Margarpatta, DWS Model Risk); 'Credit Risk & Capital Strats, AVP' (Group Strategic Analytics, Pune); multiple 'Market Risk Analyst' roles in Pune.
what_they_do_in_pune: Model validation for DWS (asset management) risk models, credit-risk capital Strats (Group Strategic Analytics), and market risk management.
personalization_hook: DB's Group Strategic Analytics has a Capital Strats team in Pune building credit-risk calculations that drive how the bank allocates capital.
winter_internship_plausibility_reason: DB India hires via campus (analyst hires, CA interns, a 3-month 'Resume Your Resume' returnship in Mumbai Risk); GSA internships are advertised for Germany, not India; no December program seen.

name: UBS (incl. ex-Credit Suisse Pune) - Pune
pune_evidence: UBS 'Market Risk Model Validation Quantitative Analyst' posting states the Model Risk Management & Control (MRMC) market-risk team has staff in Zurich, Hyderabad and Pune. UBS India careers page says its ~15,000 India staff are spread across Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad.
what_they_do_in_pune: Independent validation of market-risk models (VaR, FRTB, stress loss, RWA projections) within MRMC, plus large ex-Credit Suisse operations/tech center.
personalization_hook: UBS's MRMC market-risk validation team (Zurich/Hyderabad/Pune) independently validates VaR and FRTB models used for Pillar 1/2 capital.
winter_internship_plausibility_reason: UBS publishes an 'Internship Program India' with summer (2 months) and regular (6-12 months) internships for enrolled students, run via select institutes; a 6-week December slot is shorter than the regular track but UBS India does run off-cycle internships.
notes: Pune evidence for quant team comes via an aggregator (quintedge) mirroring a UBS posting; medium confidence. No email published on UBS India pages.

pune_evidence: BNY 'Specialist, Model Risk Management' posting located Pune/Chennai (Enterprise Model Risk Management: credit, treasury, market, pricing, forecasting models; 0-2 yrs, Master's/PhD); 'Senior Specialist, Model Risk Analytics, AI & ML' in Pune.

winter_internship_plausibility_reason: BNY India runs a 10-week Summer Intern / Early Career Program in Chennai and Pune for penultimate-year students; no winter program seen.
